builds.summary: Restoration (PvP, model) for leveling: its talents in an order chosen for questing pace, with a few leveling talents along the way. Respec into Restoration (PvP, model) at 60.
about: 32 points in Restoration, with 17 in Elemental and 2 in Enhancement. Built for PvP. On this order the key talents arrive as follows: Elemental Focus at 28, Mana Tide Totem at 52, Water Shield at 54 and Purification at 58.
In the model's rotation it keeps Flame Shock up, uses Chain Lightning on cooldown and fills with Lightning Bolt.
Questing pace in the model, in kills per hour: 70 at 20, 74 at 30, 95 at 40, 85 at 50 and 90 at 60.

While leveling it also takes Elemental Focus 1, Convection 5 and Purification 1, which pay off for questing; respec those points into Restoration (PvP, model) at 60. A model leveling path, not yet tried in game.

Gear priority per point, relative to the best stat: at level 30, spell power 1, spirit 0.21, crit rating 0.17 and intellect 0.04; at level 60, spell power 1, crit rating 0.22 and intellect 0.11. The Recommended gear panel ranks items by these weights at your level.

caveats: Elemental (#167): Flame Shock kept up, Lava Burst and Chain Lightning on cooldown, Lightning Bolt in between on the caster engine; Lava Burst gets its +20% while Flame Shock is up. Enhancement (#175): two-hander swings with Windfury (Classic chance and attack power) and Flurry, Stormstrike and Earth Shock on cooldown on the melee engine; Stormstrike's bonus counts on the share of Earth Shocks after one; Elemental Devastation counts as an average uptime. Enhancement spends mana on shocks and Stormstrike and swings white once dry; Maelstrom Weapon casts a Lightning Bolt at 5 stacks (proc rate a guess). Totems aren't modeled. Restoration stays unscored. Base stats are estimates.

Dungeon scores assume a 5-player group (#220): a tank, a healer, two more DPS and you, weighted by how often each class and spec shows up in Forever Logs. Group buffs come from the game client at your level; each provider uses the option that helps your build type (Might and Windfury for physical damage, Kings and the Elements for casters); a warrior tank keeps 5 Sunders up. Shadow Weaving, Improved Scorch and Winter's Chill only help their own caster in Forever, so they aren't group buffs. Raids and questing are unbuffed.
